name: desktop-serial-test-files
goal: The desktop unit suite keeps its deadlines when the machine is busy: test files run one after another, with every test, assertion and deadline unchanged

evidence: With files side by side, fixture tests that start git by the dozen wait on macOS process launches and pass their deadlines when the machine is busy. Expected: the same 365 tests and 3 optional ones pass with every assertion and deadline unchanged

Unchanged config, cd packages/desktop && bun run check: unit stage 7 failed, 358 passed, 3 skipped, all deadline expiries, exit 1 (/tmp/harness-desktop-resource/full-check.log). Root's two earlier runs: 2 failed each. No test was added: the suite itself is the regression
One line in packages/desktop/vite.config.ts: fileParallelism false (sha256 a49d94d270e4 to 321fef021abd). No runtime code, test, assertion, deadline, hook or fixture changed

Serial on unchanged source by flag: 365 passed, 3 skipped, 318 s (/tmp/harness-desktop-serial-unchanged.log). With the config line, cd packages/desktop && bun run check exit 0: 104 files passed, 1 skipped; 365 passed, 3 skipped in 333 s; build and audit passed (/tmp/harness-desktop-serial-check.log)

Normal desktop check passed: 365 tests, 3 optional skips; formatting, types, lint, build, audit and Swift limits passed. Independent review confirmed unchanged assertions and deadlines. Only file scheduling changes; suite takes about 5.5 minutes. Raw proof: /tmp/harness-desktop-serial-check.log.
